'''Hirael Chindiaye''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was present in the [[Adventurers' Guildhall]] in [[Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. After the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] defected to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]], he hired a team of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to [[Retaking of the Blackguard|capture]] it, so he could sell it for salvage.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hirael Chindiaye was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Hirael Chindiaye was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
